name: astra-db
description: Unofficial JEStats integration for Astra DB: live database tools, interactive views, guarded writes, vector and hybrid search, data-modeling skills, and Data API examples in five languages.

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial Astra DB tools by JEStats: explore, query, and vector-search with your coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Unofficial, community-maintained Astra DB integration by JEStats. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DataStax or IBM. Astra DB (DataStax / IBM) and HCD for Codex. The astra-db MCP server gives live tools — database overview, collection and table schemas, find, vector and hybrid search, counts, guarded inserts/updates/deletes, and schema changes that ask before anything destructive — plus canonical Data API snippets. Skills cover setup ($astra-db:setup — connect with `npx -y @erichare/astra-mcp login`, no token in chat), diagnosis ($astra-db:doctor), code review, data modeling, and migrations. Credentials come from your project's .env, environment, or Astra CLI profile.
